instruction.text: It’s playtime! There are always lots of things going on at the park. Select the swing to hear what’s happening.

finish.text: Bobby and Valentina are playing in the park. Valentina has been playing on the swing alone for a long time. Now Bobby is standing in front of the swing and crying.

instruction.text: What could Valentina be thinking right now? Listen and select the correct option.

b.sound: Woohooo! This is amazing! I never want to get off of the swing.
I am so sad... I hate playing on the swing.

instruction.text: What do you think Bobby is thinking right now? Listen and select the correct option.

b.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>Valentina has been on the swing for way too long! I want to use it too.</prosody>
ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>I am so happy Valentina is having fun on the swing. She should keep playing on it.</prosody>

instruction.text: Spell the word to find out what just happened between Valentina and Bobby.

feedback.finish: A conflict is a problem between people. It can happen when people want different things.

instruction.text: Select the images to hear Bobby’s ideas for solving this problem. Are they helpful or not? Drag the ideas into the correct categories.
